description: The Solar Patrol Service publishes active-region, full-disk and weekly flare forecasts. It combines sunspot drawings and satellite observations, with different reporting conventions for daily and weekly products. The resource is documented by Solar Department, Astronomical Institute of the Czech Academy of Sciences (AI CAS). The documented physical domain is Solar; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Continuous/RT Run (Flare Scoreboard). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Ground-based active-region forecasts are weather-dependent, and weekly forecasts are not expressed as probabilities. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
